entry.title: Poli-Juicebox 1.5.0
entry.summary: Low-latency voice shaper: pitch and formant shifting (MtF, FtM), spectral tamer, harmonic shaper, formant filter, air and 50 categorized presets **For:** second-generation MPCs (MPC Live III, One G2, Key G2, XL) on MPC OS 3.10.1 or later. **Tested on:** MPC Live III, MPC OS 3.10.1. **Install:** from the Open MPC catalog or the Plugin Manager, or by hand: unzip, copy the folder inside `portable/` into `VST2 Plugins` at the root of a drive, turn on Preferences > Enhancements > External Plugin Supp
